from test.support import import_helper
grp = import_helper.import_module('grp')

def check_value(value):
    assert len(value) == 4, ('assertEqual', len(value), 4)
    assert value[0] == value.gr_name, ('assertEqual', value[0], value.gr_name)
    assert isinstance(value.gr_name, str), ('assertIsInstance', value.gr_name, str)
    assert value[1] == value.gr_passwd, ('assertEqual', value[1], value.gr_passwd)
    assert isinstance(value.gr_passwd, str), ('assertIsInstance', value.gr_passwd, str)
    assert value[2] == value.gr_gid, ('assertEqual', value[2], value.gr_gid)
    assert isinstance(value.gr_gid, int), ('assertIsInstance', value.gr_gid, int)
    assert value[3] == value.gr_mem, ('assertEqual', value[3], value.gr_mem)
    assert isinstance(value.gr_mem, list), ('assertIsInstance', value.gr_mem, list)

def _t():
    entries = grp.getgrall()
    for e in entries:
        check_value(e)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')
